best_parts: node p4_t19a / p4_t19b: two distinct wrong models for the electrical urine target, each with its own refutation and a sure_note
node p5_t6a / p5_t6b: the adult-head and adult-leg errors are separate traps with separate feedback, so the path shows which chart error the learner holds
node p1_t17 / p1_t16: each wrong direction gets its own tempting-then-refute feedback and a sure_note
flaws: node p5 (correct option 'Head is a bigger share, legs smaller, so use an age chart' is the longest and the only one naming an age chart: findable by form)
node p6 (correct option is the longest of the three and the only one that names the reason in full; mild telegraphing)
segment: no fast lane for a learner who is sure on p1 or p3; every probe is walked in full, which costs time at 1 a.m.

best_parts: node rate_now / rate_p2: decision framing ('What do you do?') with a 'Show me the rule' fallback after a miss, so a learner is never left stuck
node elec_t19 and elec_show: the electrical target is tested as a three-way choice with both adult and child traps and a clear rule after
node am_reveal: the arithmetic is shown as a single chain (half of 4 x 50 x 40, minus 1,000 mL, over 6 h)
flaws: node ambulance: only one trap option (670 mL/h) plus the key, so a learner can guess from two choices
node fluid_p: both wrong options (start full rate on top, restart from zero) share one feedback node fluid_t4, so the path cannot tell which wrong model the learner holds
node child_p and esc_p: two trap options each send to one shared feedback node (child_t19, esc_t23); ch_size sends both trap options to ch_t6
node child_p, elec_p, esc_p, ch_size, rate_p2: no hint option on these probes, so a learner who is unsure has no help before a guess; key positions cluster in 1-2
node mechanism: only one wrong option plus the key and a hint (two-choice probe)

best_parts: node start_ok -> child_urine (skip): a sure, correct learner can skip the why-explanation, the expertise-reversal fast lane the rubric asks for
node start_t16 / start_reveal and child_t10 / child_reveal: a 'Show me the answer' route after a wrong pick, a hint ladder plus a reveal, so no learner is left at a dead end
node contrast: the two-patient urine contrast with separate wrong-direction feedback (co_t16, co_t17) and a clear rule in co_reveal
node tb_t_std / tb_t_small: the two adult-chart errors go to separate feedback nodes, each naming the wrong model
flaws: node ambulance: only one trap option (670 mL/h) plus the key and a hint; a two-choice probe
node mechanism: only one wrong option plus the key and a hint; a two-choice probe
node start: the sure_note on start_t16 and start_t17 is fine, but the wrong-option feedback is long for a 1 a.m. reader (about 45 words per wrong pick)
segment: the TR6 and TR4 traps are each met on one probe only (child_tbsa and ambulance), so the segment gives no within-segment re-test for them

merge_ideas: c's skip fast lane and reveal route, with a's separate per-error feedback nodes on p3/p4/p5 (distinct wrong models, separate refutations)
b's rate_now framing (what do you do, at the bedside) with a's p2 two-patient contrast, so the titration backbone is met in clinical form and in contrast form
add a third distractor to ambulance and mechanism in c, each mapped to a distinct trap (arrival-clock for TR2, a plausible wrong reason for TR23)
